finding: Router supplied and then moved 1 time(s). Over 384h the best realized dollar rate was 2.98%, and the largest gap between the two venues reached 1.073pp against a round-trip hurdle of 1.059pp — so the edge cleared, and only just. It held the better-paying venue on 62% of samples, earning 9.29 against 1.0304 of cost. A boundary that is crossed narrowly is the interesting case: the same agent declined to move on a 0.3pp edge earlier in this tape.
